title: Yuca Frita con Chicharrón
description: Yuca Frita con Chicharrón is a dish from El Salvador featuring cassava root, pork belly, garlic, white cabbage. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 26 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 14 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
